name: Voice Phone Agent - Gemini 2.5 Flash + ElevenLabs

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  c.id, c.name, c.phone, c.email,
  i.invoice_number, i.amount, i.due_date, i.status
FROM customers c
JOIN invoices i ON c.id = i.customer_id
WHERE c.name ILIKE '%{{ $json.kunde }}%'
  OR i.invoice_number = '{{ $json.details }}'
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  c.id, c.name, c.phone, c.email,
  a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time,
  a.description, a.location
FROM customers c
JOIN appointments a ON c.id = a.customer_id
WHERE c.name ILIKE '%{{ $json.kunde }}%'
  AND a.appointment_date >= CURRENT_DATE
ORDER BY a.appointment_date ASC
LIMIT 1

parameters.values: ={{ $('Code: ElevenLabs Agent konfigurieren').first().json.kunde_id }}, '{{ $('Code: Intent parsen').first().json.intent }}', '{{ $json.conversation_id }}', 'initiated', NOW()

parameters.columns: status, duration_seconds, transcript, ended_at, outcome_analysis, sentiment
